citations.quote: ECOG 2 (limited activity due to fatigue and dyspnea)

candidates.description: A scale used to assess the functional status of cancer patients.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numeric value associated with 'ECOG' or 'Performance status'.
candidates.measurement_definition: The Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score, where 0 represents fully active and 4 represents completely disabled.
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The evidence does not specify if scores were captured at a single baseline visit or averaged over time.

candidates.description: The proportion of tumor cells expressing the Programmed Death-Ligand 1 (PD-L1) protein.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the percentage value associated with 'PD-L1 expression' or 'PD-L1 status'.
candidates.measurement_definition: The percentage (%) of tumor cells positive for PD-L1 expression as determined by immunohistochemistry (IHC).
candidates.name: PD-L1 Expression
candidates.uncertainty: The specific IHC assay used (e.g., 22C3) is mentioned in some plans but not consistently documented for all patients.

limitations: Limited sample size of patients across the provided excerpts.
Some molecular markers (e.g., PD-L1) were listed as 'pending' in certain excerpts.
Variability in how performance status is described (some with qualitative descriptions, some with just the numeric score).
summary: The evidence identifies baseline clinical variables including performance status and PD-L1 expression levels in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), specifically those with KRAS mutations.
